families: nfl/season-totals/2012.json .. 2025.json (gamesPlayed per player-season, keyed by Sleeper id)
nflverse/playerids.json (schemaVersion 2): bySleeper (Sleeper-id-keyed crosswalk: gsisId, draftYear, draftRound, draftPick, undrafted) + ids (gsisId-keyed: sleeperId, name, position)
source.join: For each bySleeper[sleeperId] entry, resolve position via ids[bySleeper[sleeperId].gsisId].position. Draft group from draftRound/undrafted: undrafted===true -> 'undrafted'; draftRound===1 -> 'r1'; draftRound in {2,3} -> 'day2'; draftRound in {4,5,6,7} -> 'day3'. Entry year is bySleeper[sleeperId].draftYear (reads as an entry year for both drafted and undrafted rows, per rookie-calibration.md Q1(b)).
source.predicate: For each crosswalk player with entry year >= 2013 and a skill position (QB/RB/WR/TE): walk target seasons forward from the entry year (years_exp = 0, 1, 2, ...; target season = entry year + years_exp), stop at the first target season preceded by any season (from the entry year up to, but not including, that target season) with gamesPlayed >= 8, and skip emitting a row at years_exp >= 2 when the player recorded zero games in both the target season and the season immediately prior (out of the league, so the app would have no row for him) -- the walk itself continues past a skipped row, it does not stop there. A target season beyond the last available season-totals year (2025) is never walked.
source.absenceConvention: A player absent from a season's season-totals file counts as gamesPlayed=0 for that season.
source.noCommittedArtifact: Unlike calibration arc slice 1's fixture (a trimmed copy of a data-repo-committed, SHA-anchored artifact), this panel has no committed data-repo artifact behind it -- Session 1 assembled it directly from the two live families above. This source block is the full derivation recipe, precise enough to re-derive by hand; it proves the fixture is internally consistent and tamper-evident, not that the join/predicate above were the right ones to run. See rookie-availability.md Q5 and section 7 item 1 (a committed rookie availability panel, filed as a data-repo ask, not planned in this slice).
